title: Add Folder Empty Policy and File Godfile Policy
description: Add a new Folder policy with Illegal/Empty statute (autofixable by removing empty folders). Extend the File policy with Illegal/Use Godfile statute that checks files against .repo/files.json godfile list.
summary: Added two new policies to repo CLI: (1) Folder policy with BreachFolderIllegalEmpty (autofixable, removes empty folders) and (2) File policy with BreachFileIllegalUseGodfile (checks files against .repo/files.json). Both policies only run for ScopeRepo, skip excluded dirs (.git, .repo, node_modules, .venv, .nx), and have 8 passing tests. Also created .repo/files.json godfile with 4670 tracked files, added autofix routing in Fix function for folder-level breachs, and fixed a pre-existing build error with interactionResourceType.
